name: Masters Precision Machining Inc.
old_description: We are Masters Precision Machining. We provide a wide range of machining, turning, milling, fabricating and prototyping services for our customers.
about:
Masters Precision Machining Inc. is based in Kent, Ohio, where it provides a range of machining, turning, milling, fabricating, and prototyping services. The company does not disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders in public materials.

Its core offerings center on production machining and value‑added assemblies, covering processes such as CNC machining, turning, milling, and metal fabrication. The shop serves both prototype and production quantities, though specific facility dimensions, employee count, equipment roster, and annual volume figures are not provided.

The firm explicitly identifies aerospace and aeronautics as a key industry served and notes a broader customer base across multiple sectors, though no additional industries are named in the available information.

Masters Precision Machining positions itself on expert knowledge and superior customer service, with a stated goal of completing every job right the first time and on schedule. The company’s tagline, “Measuring Up to a Higher Standard,” underscores that differentiation.
